content:
nina: Packaging window in 23m for private/vpc onprem. Primary ask: ensure manifest chunk ordering preserved and cosign pubkey is on all mirrors.

omar: I'm switching the manifest writer to deterministic-chunk-order mode. That should reduce reordering under the transport bridge. Will push in 5m.

dave: Also proposing a small pull jitter in escort: jitter=random(0ms,2500ms) per chunk fetch. Prevents synchronized TCP bursts.

ops-cara: Ops constraint: if any lane reports >4 verify failures or >120s pull latency for 3m, we abort and roll back. I'll set alerts.

pkg-bot: [pkg-bot] preflight: gzip OK, multi-arch tags present (amd64,arm64), manifest schema v2.1 OK.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] preparing release: private-installer@v2024.06.14 -> staging sha256:0f1e...b77a. Upload path s3://redwood-offline/releases/1747654321/. Pending cosign.

omar: Pushed deterministic ordering. Also added a chunk-seq header so mirrors can validate ordering.

nina: Good. Who's holding cosign key today? Need signer handoff and KMS audit id.

ops-cara: KMS signer=projects/prod/keys/installer-signer-03. Audit id KMS-2024-06-14-02 attached once signed.

pkg-bot: [pkg-bot] cosign: signed by installer-signer-03. pubkey uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign-2024-06.pub.

dave: Reminder: add auto-invalidate step for cosign cache on first seed (mirror-agent cache ttl=0 on first pull). I'll push script.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary seeds scheduled: lanes=[alpha,beta,gamma], seeds=6, spacing=75s, observe=25m. Current pin -> sha256:0f1e...b77a.

pkg-bot: [pkg-bot] canary update (10m): alpha OK, beta OK, gamma partial (2/2 nodes had stale cosign.pub).

omar: Pushing cache invalidation to gamma nodes now.

ops-cara: Invalidation applied. If verification failures persist after 2 retries, we will evict and re-seed.

pkg-bot: (18m) gamma recovered after cache refresh. All seeds verified. Throughput steady.

nina: Proceed to rolling batches in 12m. Reminder: note the deterministic manifest change in release notes and bump TTL to 120d.

dave: Post-release task: add manifest-order unit test to packaging CI and a synthetic shipping test for mirrors. Filing ticket.

ops-cara: Rollback commands saved in runbook:
```
deploy-bot rollback --target private-installer --pin v2024.05.30
opsctl escort evict --selector release=canary
```

deploy-bot: [deploybot] rolling batches started: batch_size=4 pause_between=10m.

pkg-bot: (end) Rolling complete. No post-rollout evictions. KMS audit KMS-2024-06-14-02 logged. Release notes pushed to private-customers.

nina: Great work. Closing thread. If anyone sees leftover stale pubkeys, ping me and I'll coordinate mirror flush.

omar: One last note: added telemetry metric manifest.reorder.count for future monitoring.
